behaviors.description: Read back added and modified remote presentation properties.
behaviors.expected: Comment, description, homepage and icon match both sets of supplied values.

behaviors.description: Persist enumeration policy through add and opposing modifications.
behaviors.expected: Public options reports no-enumerate, clears it, then reports it again.

behaviors.description: Exercise dependency policy through add and opposing modifications.
behaviors.preconditions: Filtered app-only remote and separate dependency remote.
behaviors.expected: Excluding dependency remote blocks install; enabling it permits exact app/runtime commits.

behaviors.description: Enable verification against unsigned input, then disable it.
behaviors.expected: Signature verification prevents deployment until disabled.

behaviors.description: Install foreign architecture using an ambiguous architecture-free name.
behaviors.preconditions: queries fixtures with native and foreign copies.
behaviors.expected: Only the exact foreign commit is deployed.

behaviors.description: Inspect permissions, remote metadata and commit parent.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference-exported queries fixture metadata and A/B ancestry.
behaviors.expected: Network permission, exact reference metadata and independently known A parent.

behaviors.description: Query foreign remote copy instead of native alternative.
behaviors.expected: Exact foreign full ref and reference commit.

behaviors.description: Select installed architecture in list and info.
behaviors.preconditions: Both native and foreign copies installed.
behaviors.expected: Lists exclude competing architecture; info selects exact foreign commit.

behaviors.description: Remove foreign copy by architecture-free app name.
behaviors.preconditions: Both native and foreign copies installed.
behaviors.expected: Only foreign copy removed; exact native commit retained.

behaviors.description: Update only foreign copy by architecture-free app name.
behaviors.preconditions: Both architectures installed at A and both advertise B.
behaviors.expected: Foreign advances to B; native remains A.

behaviors.description: Select apps and runtimes independently during updates.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference app and runtime each have A/B versions.
behaviors.expected: Each type selector changes selected kind to B and retains excluded kind at A.

behaviors.description: Update app with its runtime absent but available.
behaviors.preconditions: App installed without dependencies and B advertised.
behaviors.expected: App reaches B without installing its required runtime.

behaviors.description: Remove deployment while preserving the ref for local reinstall.
behaviors.preconditions: A installed before B is advertised.
behaviors.expected: keep-ref permits local A reinstall; ordinary uninstall prevents it.

behaviors.description: App-only matching rejects a runtime name and removes an app name.
behaviors.expected: Rejected runtime removal preserves both; app removal retains runtime commit.

behaviors.description: Runtime-only matching rejects an app name and accepts an unused runtime name.
behaviors.expected: Rejected app removal preserves both; after removing dependent app, runtime selector removes runtime.

behaviors.description: Reject opposite-kind candidates when installing by ID.
behaviors.preconditions: Available app/runtime refs and empty installation.
behaviors.expected: App-only rejects runtime ID; runtime-only rejects app ID; no deployment.

behaviors.description: Reject opposite-kind candidates in remote queries by ID.
behaviors.expected: App-only rejects runtime ID; runtime-only rejects app ID.

behaviors.description: Persist languages through two writes.
behaviors.expected: Each get returns exactly the last value.

behaviors.description: Add duplicate remote with conflicting properties.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user state and A repository.
behaviors.expected: Original URL, title and priority survive.

behaviors.description: Add description-file remote.
behaviors.expected: Description URL and title are reported exactly.

behaviors.description: Deny all with an explicit runtime allowance, then clear filter.
behaviors.expected: Only runtime is visible and installable; clearing restores both refs.

behaviors.description: Replace and clear filter using duplicate description-file additions.
behaviors.expected: Runtime-only changes to app-only, then both refs.

behaviors.description: Enumerate uninstalled remote refs with type and architecture filters.
behaviors.expected: Exact app/runtime sets for each query.

behaviors.description: Install an application description.
behaviors.expected: Described app and dependency commits installed.

behaviors.description: Download A without deployment, then deploy locally with B advertised.
behaviors.expected: No refs installed after download; local deployment selects A.

behaviors.description: Install app while suppressing dependency installation.
behaviors.expected: Only application A is deployed.

behaviors.description: Query installed metadata, origin, runtime and typed ref lists.
behaviors.expected: Exact fixture metadata and selected refs.

behaviors.description: Query path access before and after filesystem grants.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed app with no host filesystem grant.
behaviors.expected: Hidden, read-only, then read-write access.

behaviors.description: Force removal of an origin still used by installed refs.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary deletion fails; force removes remote and retains deployments.

behaviors.description: Remove app then collect its unpinned dependency.
behaviors.expected: Runtime remains after app removal and disappears after unused cleanup.

behaviors.description: Pin an automatic dependency across unused cleanup, then remove pin.
behaviors.expected: Pin persists, protects runtime, and removing it permits cleanup.

behaviors.description: Uninstall every deployed ref.
behaviors.expected: Both app and runtime disappear.

behaviors.description: Install again with or-update.
behaviors.expected: Installed app changes to B.

behaviors.description: Reinstall existing app with newer tip available.
behaviors.expected: Reinstall replaces A with B.

behaviors.description: Update two distinct apps and an updatable runtime without a ref selector.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent queries A/B repositories contain distinct commits for Query/test, QuerySecond/test and Query.Data/next; all three are installed at A.
behaviors.expected: A no-ref update advances both apps and the runtime to their exact independently prepared B commits, retaining the unchanged base runtime commit.

behaviors.description: Download B without deployment, then deploy without pulling.
behaviors.preconditions: A installed; B available; payload faults controllable.
behaviors.expected: Download leaves A installed; local deployment reaches B despite denied payloads.

behaviors.description: Downgrade B to explicitly selected A.
behaviors.expected: A installed while remote tip remains B.

behaviors.description: Disable origin during available update, then enable.
behaviors.expected: Disabled remote is only shown on request, blocks update, and enabling permits B.

behaviors.description: Mask an installed ref then remove its mask.
behaviors.expected: Stored mask blocks B; removal clears enumeration and permits B.

behaviors.description: List pending remote updates before and after deployment.
behaviors.preconditions: A app and unchanged runtime installed; B advertised.
behaviors.expected: Only app listed before update; no refs afterward.

behaviors.description: Query remote commit while older local app is installed.
behaviors.expected: Remote ref/commit is exactly B; local deployment stays A.

behaviors.description: Query remote commit history.
behaviors.expected: Both exact A and B commits appear.
